description: Heat on the CFD patches with subcycling (G 7 1): the refinement transports T on all grids in flux form (SSP-RK3, WENO face values H 15 4, implicit diffusion D 20 2); warm water in the dam column, the front crosses the patch edge x = 0.3; flux registers at the patch edges (refluxing after the two steps of the patch), density and viscosity from T (H 3 1) at the patch edges and the cells around the patch.
covers: cfd_amr_scalar: SSP-RK3 flux form on all grids, flux registers, refluxing (G 7 1)
rmix/vmix: density from T at the patch edges
heat_RK3 on the patches as the holder of T
